arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Vector, list, or matrix to subset.

arguments.name: index
arguments.text: One-based positions, names, or a logical mask. Zero is ignored. A negative index drops those positions.

arguments.name: drop
arguments.text: When true, a one-row or one-column matrix subset becomes a vector.

origin.details: Positions start at 1. On a matrix, a single index walks down columns, and two indexes select rows and then columns. Names of the selected elements are kept, in the order of the index.
origin.value: The selected elements, or a matrix when two dimensions remain.
